description: Scenario-independence for non-branching stages. Four stages — debug_application (Feature 1), native_embedding (Feature 2), dotnet_module (Feature 4.3), and native_module (Feature 4.4) — do not read the `scenario` selector at all. Supplying an arbitrary `scenario` value must therefore produce byte-for-byte the same artifact report as the canonical command. These synthetic cases pin that idempotence/robustness property (an unexpected extra field is ignored, not an error), which the native suite never verifies because it only sends the bare commands.
